statement: Static source contracts require the existing Linux/GCC GNS compile job to configure the profile preset and build the common library, server, shipping client, QA client and both macro fixtures against pinned Tracy. The bootstrap installs NumPy and Pillow before enabling tests. Disposable TCP accept attempts retain job and future-wait zones without process-lifetime thread-name registration; persistent workers remain named. The licence disclosure links to the repository-hosted notice from generated documentation. Enabled native compile/link qualification is pending a successful CI run; no local profile configure or application build is claimed. Windows and macOS enabled builds, profiler captures and GPU execution remain outside this check. Release/perf lanes retain Tracy disabled.
